title: Fish Soup

time_min: 50
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 1 scorpionfish of 500 g ready for cooking
- 200 g of ditalini
- 250 g of ramati tomatoes
- 2 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- 2 shallots
- 1 tablespoon of chopped parsley
- to taste Salt and pepper
## Method
1. Blanch the tomatoes in lightly salted water.
2. Drain them, peel them, divide them into quarters, remove the seeds and chop the pulp.
3. Peel and slice the shallots, sauté them in a saucepan with the oil for 3 minutes, add the tomato pulp and 8 dl of water, bring to a boil, salt and let cook for 10 minutes.
4. Add the fish, cook it for about 10 minutes, then drain it, debone it and break the flesh into pieces.
5. Add the pasta to the sauce and cook it.
6. Turn off the heat, distribute the preparation among the plates, place the fish on top and sprinkle with parsley and a grind of pepper.
